articles.title: Donald Trump assassination attempt? Venezuelan man living illegally in US arrested with guns near White House, said voices in his head told him to kill the President
articles.description: Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos was arrested near the White House after being found with firearms and ammunition. He now faces multiple charges, including unlawful possession of firearms and unauthorized vehicle use.

articles.title: Indian Cultural Pride Or Provocation? The Fine Line
articles.description: Indian celebrations abroad often become the centre of cultural and political controversy, especially on social media platforms. From a dance event in Houston to the backlash it triggered, where does cultural pride end and provocation begin? Why are Indian cultural expressions drawing outrage, and what does this reveal about the changing politics of identity and belonging? Is the backlash about discomfort over cultural differences, racism, or something deeper? On Beyond Borders Ananya Dasgupta examines the fine line between celebrating your heritage and being accused of provoking others.
